description:
https://flavorfoley.com/weiwardromance ← Streaming, off vocal, MV materials, etc 

炜WARD ROMANCE ft. Feng Yi
– 
JamieP: "these lovely lovely individuals you see below me here made me mix Thirty Five freaking tracks of crowd vocals for this song. Thirty Five. i know a lot of you aren’t music producers yourself so i need to impress upon you just how many tracks of vocals that is. there are entire songs with full bands and four part vocal harmonies that have half as many tracks as just the crowd chants on this song. rice thought it would be a very funny idea to render out every single Synthesizer V voicebank we collectively own and mix them as one big crowd. to be perfectly clear (and PLEASE don’t add all these names to vocaDB i beg of you), that is Kasane Teto, Eleanor Forte, Hayden, Kevin, Lin Lai, Mai, Wei Shu, Yuma, Yun Quan, ASTERIAN, SAROS, D-Lin, Eri, Ritchy, Yi Xi, Haruno Sora, Kyomachi Seika, Tsuina-chan, ANRI (AKA Airi Lin), JUN (AKA Juneau Kheang), Xingchen, POPY, ROSE, Ayame, Sheena, Weina, OSCAR, SOLARIA, Gumi from Megpoid (SynthV), Koharu Rikka, Frimomen, and Tsurumaki Maki all singing in unison. and i had to mix it. and VANE didn’t even LABEL THEIR TRACKS"

Vane Lily: “i forgor"

rice: "One of my favorite kinds of music is chic, 'Chinese-style' songs made by non-Chinese producers, so I wanted to contribute to the genre. Since FLAVOR FOLEY is only 1/3rd Chinese, we technically count as a non-Chinese producer by majority."

– 
Art by @kheechuu  "they let a rat into the flavor foley kitchen and so I cooked and I served 🐀"
